description_for_human: Noshi — generate Japanese gift envelope bands.
description_for_model: Noshi (https://noshi.moab.jp) is a free bilingual tool for generating noshi (gift envelope bands). Machine overview at https://noshi.moab.jp/llms.txt, open sitemap at https://noshi.moab.jp/sitemap.xml, and a read-only JSON API at https://noshi.moab.jp/api/v1 (OpenAPI at /api/v1/openapi.json). The generator itself runs fully in the browser.
